AS3 Commons Logging: core API subset, unmodified upstream source.

Source: https://github.com/bridgeZS/as3commons/tree/229b4aec42c8b22fde763d09def0055e3e07416e/as3-commons-logging
Revision: 229b4aec42c8b22fde763d09def0055e3e07416e

Included: org.as3commons.logging.api and logging.util.toLogName, the ten
source files required by FlashSpan. No external logging targets are included.

Upstream's package license is Apache-2.0 (LICENSE.txt). The individual source
files additionally carry their original MIT license notices, preserved here.
